title: Proposal flow: main is production, then proposals become tasks

message.text: Plan, with the picture: /framework/ai/2026-09-30/proposal-flow/plan.md. Wave A first, as you said — three minions side by side in one worktree: the monitor on health.mjs (template changes only: console, shot, stall over 2 s), validated writes then the jsonl guard, and the reader learning experiment/review so AI 2 loads with zero unknown-verb warnings. Each merges on its own through the review gate. Wave B (Proposal class, node-led loop, merge rows, template weights, page.jsonl archiving and promotion) is briefed when A lands.

Monitor started: I'm extending Server/health.mjs so only template changes (JS, CSS, HTML) trigger a check. Each check looks for console errors, takes a 1920 screenshot, flags stalls over 2 s and reports to the editing agent's task. I'm also making health-supervisor a single instance per tree. I'll be back here with the proofs when it's ready to merge.

Monitor: ready to merge (commits df74c22a and 8ef74ea2 on worktree/proposal-flow). Only template changes (JS, CSS, HTML) trigger a check now. Each check reports console errors, stalls over 2 s and unknown-verb warnings, takes a 1920 screenshot, and writes one line to the editing agent's task. All four proofs passed:
- a 3 s busy page was flagged as a 3.0 s stall: /framework/ai/2026-09-30/proposal-flow/monitor/proof/stall-shot.png
- a throw in a page.js was caught, then cleared once the file was restored: /framework/ai/2026-09-30/proposal-flow/monitor/proof/health-log-excerpt.jsonl
- appending a log line ran no check: /framework/ai/2026-09-30/proposal-flow/monitor/proof/watcher-console.log
- starting the supervisor twice left one running
The supervisor change only takes effect after the main supervisor is restarted once. How to run it is in Server/doc/health.md.

validated-writes started: I'm making one list of what a line in each log file may look like, and teaching append.mjs and append_log to refuse a line that doesn't fit, before it is written. The guard that blocks a shell append to a .jsonl gets switched on last, once the tool route is the default everywhere.

Monitor: the review fix is done, ready to merge (commit b0a71a66, after df74c22a and 8ef74ea2, on worktree/proposal-flow). The monitor now finds the editing task even when it was opened days ago (proof: /framework/ai/2026-09-30/proposal-flow/monitor/proof/task-lookup.log). The console from starting two supervisors is attached at /framework/ai/2026-09-30/proposal-flow/monitor/proof/supervisor-twice.log. The answers are in /framework/ai/2026-09-30/proposal-flow/review.md.

validated-writes is **ready to merge** (worktree/proposal-flow, commits fa238c6a, 66060694, 4f1abcbc, e78cf804, afcad6e5). One schema, `.claude/hooks/jsonl-schema.mjs`, covers task, day, board, asks and page logs. `append.mjs` and `append_log` now refuse a line that doesn't fit and print the right shape. The guard hook is wired on Bash and PowerShell, and it blocked my own test append live.

Proof: a flat `{at,task,msg}` line is refused (exit 3, nothing written), while `experiment` and `review` lines are accepted. The schema/reader agreement test passes 30 of 30, the guard test passes 16 of 16, and my task log was written only through the tool ([task](/framework/ai/2026-09-30/proposal-flow/validated-writes/)). Note: the `append_log` check only takes effect after a Servex restart.

Still open, outside my fence: about 25 node scripts append `.jsonl` without the schema. Do `Server/plugins/SocketServer/Append.js`, `Server/review.mjs` and `.claude/hooks/ledger.mjs` first. The full list is in my task log.

Wave A status: the monitor and validated-writes are built, reviewed by fresh eyes (one fix each, both answered), and sit on the branch; verbs-reader is mid-build on JSONL.js. All three land in one merge when it commits, then one Servex restart turns on the append_log check. Nine percent of the last three days' hand-written log lines would now be refused — that is what the validation is for.

Monitor: done (commit d0c2c4f1 on worktree/proposal-flow). The monitor's own screen resize can no longer count as the page's stall. A shared-module edit now puts one summary line on the card instead of eight, and the doc says why .md changes are not checked. Item 8's cheap layout anomaly check is deferred, together with the layout scan.

Review finding 2 is fixed. Since 39f8e7ec, the schema test fails if a verb is still listed as `pending` after the reader already has it. 27e699b6 then took `experiment` and `review` off that list, because verbs-reader's 39700c9b taught the reader both. The test passes 33 of 33, and the fix is noted under finding 2 in [review.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-30/proposal-flow/). Both commits are on worktree/proposal-flow, ready to merge.

Ready to merge: ext/JSONL now knows experiment and review (rendered as one line each, e.g. "review: found 7, real 6, fixed 6"), and the reader recognizes three old flat-line shapes instead of warning on each stray key. On /framework/ai2/ headless this took unknown-verb console warnings from 76 to 6 — the last 6 are two different, still-being-invented verbs ("shots", "bands") from another in-flight task, correctly left alone since that's outside this task's experiment+review scope. Committed 39700c9b on worktree/proposal-flow; demo screenshot and full numbers are in task.jsonl.

Pacing cut applied: scope is items 9–12 only, one Sonnet minion, no review beyond the gate. The item-8 anomaly check is stopped; the monitor, validated writes + guard, and the verbs are all on the branch and reviewed. One last Sonnet commit (verbs-reader: the JSONL readme's shell append → the validated route, and the shots/bands verbs), then the gate's review, the merge, and one Servex restart. Then I stop. Wave B waits.

Fixed all 4 review items, committed 9cf84e2e (same 7 files, still worktree/proposal-flow). Registered `shots`/`bands` (review.mjs's own lines) — that was the last 6 warnings, now 0 on /framework/ai2/ and /framework/ai/ both. readme.md's append line now points at the validated append.mjs route. Fixed the flat-line docs to match what apply() actually does (an at-only line folds into assign, doesn't warn). Shortened the overview card description so it stops truncating at 1920, trimmed the 3 long decisions.md paragraphs by about half. One thing flagged, not fixed myself (outside my fence): .claude/hooks/jsonl-schema.mjs needs `bands` added and `shots` dropped from its `pending` list, or jsonl-schema.test.mjs fails those 2 checks — that's the validated-writes minion's file. Ready to merge.

Wave A is in main (merge 1ebc924e). The monitor now checks every template change and never a log append; every log write is validated before it lands and a shell append to a .jsonl is blocked; the board loads with zero unknown-verb warnings (was 76). One Servex restart next, then I stop as asked. Wave B and the item-8 anomaly check wait on your pacing call. Spend: three minions $17, four gate reviews $3.70.
